reason: Primary purpose is session navigation: the plugin extends DeepSeek Harness Web’s conversation UI to create child sessions from completed turns and show lineage through a family-tree popover. Evidence from the README and package metadata shows this is a UI/plugin feature set using harness session fork APIs, with stated scope limited to branching and lineage viewing rather than file or log rewrites.

summaries.zh: 该插件面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话界面，提供从已完成回合发起分支会话并展示父子会话关系树的交互，用于查看和跳转会话分支来源。
summaries.en: This plugin adds branching controls to DeepSeek Harness Web conversations so users can fork from completed turns and inspect parent-child session lineage through a family-tree interface.

capabilities: Session lineage tree rendering in UI
Web-client interaction with session fork APIs

reasons.code: The plugin adds a header action and historical turn controls to fork at completed turn/end sequences rather than rewinding files.
It displays a family-tree popover plus parent session chip for browsing branch lineage.
Manifest and package metadata declare a DeepSeek Harness web client plugin with runtime UI dependencies and exported client bundle, indicating UI-level execution.

capabilities: Session lineage tree rendering in UI
Web-client interaction with session fork APIs
